# CHANGELOG Template

Use this exact template. No replacements needed.

```markdown
# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]
```

## Notes

- This is the [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) format
- No comparison links yet because there are no tags to compare against
- The `release` skill will populate version sections and comparison links on the first release
- The `## [Unreleased]` heading is always present, even when empty
